He has extremely high demands when begging, for example, he refuses ordinary food, is very picky about food quality, and asks for healthy, clean, and nutritious food. He even asks others to exchange a clean copper coin for him. Every time he receives money, he records it in an account book and tells the giver, "I will repay your kindness, the future is long."
